**Company Description**
Arai Technology is an IT consulting company specializing in marketing technology (MarTech) consulting for organizations seeking to modernize their marketing operations. The company helps clients align technology, data, and digital marketing systems to improve customer engagement, campaign performance, and business growth. Core services include MarTech strategy, platform selection, CRM and marketing automation support, data integration, and digital transformation. Arai Technology partners with businesses to turn technology investments into measurable business outcomes through practical, outcome-focused advisory and implementation support.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Business Analyst is a full-time, hybrid role based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with flexibility for partial work from home. This role is responsible for analyzing business processes, gathering and documenting business requirements, and translating them into clear, actionable solution designs for marketing technology and related systems. Day-to-day activities include leading stakeholder workshops, conducting detailed data and process analysis, preparing functional specifications, and collaborating with technical teams to ensure solutions meet business goals. The Senior Business Analyst will also support project planning, contribute to MarTech and CRM implementation initiatives, validate solutions through testing, and provide ongoing optimization recommendations. In addition, this role involves preparing concise documentation, reports, and presentations, and ensuring effective communication among business, technology, and vendor partners.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong Analytical Skills and ability to interpret data, identify trends, and develop insights that inform business and technology decisions.
* Proficiency in Business Analysis and Business Requirements gathering, including process mapping, use case development, and functional specifications.
* Experience in Business Process design and improvement, with the ability to assess current workflows and recommend optimized, scalable processes.
* Excellent Communication skills for engaging stakeholders, facilitating workshops, and presenting complex information in a clear, structured manner.
* Proven experience as a Business Analyst or Senior Business Analyst in IT, consulting, or MarTech-related projects.
* Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation platforms, and data integration concepts; experience in digital transformation initiatives is an advantage.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in cross-functional and multicultural environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; relevant professional certifications (e.g., CBAP, PMI-PBA) are a plus.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality outputs within agreed timelines.

An engineer owning the data and BI layer of our CTRM platform end to end: getting market and trading data in, modelling it, keeping it correct, and putting it in front of traders, analysts and management in a form they use every day. You work directly with traders, operations, the commercial team, the senior data scientist and the founders — no account manager in between.

The platform we are building exists so that anyone involved in a deal can see prices, flows, positions and margin across the chain, at any moment, on agreed and versioned definitions. **About The Role**
A hands-on QA engineer owning the quality of our CTRM platform end to end: deciding what has to be tested, building the automation, finding the defects that matter and making sure they stay fixed. You work directly with backend engineers, the product manager, the data team, and the traders and finance users who will run their business on the system — no account manager in between.
  
  
Agents write most of the code here. That makes testing more important, not less: the team ships quickly, and a large part of quality now depends on independent verification that the system does what the business needs, not what the code happens to do.
  
  
What the work looks like
  
  
The system we are building exists so that anyone involved in a deal can reconstruct the P&L between any two points of the chain, at any moment, on an agreed and versioned allocation basis. A defect here is rarely a broken button. It is a pricing formula averaged over the wrong period, a provisional cost that is never replaced by the actual, a figure that changes when someone reruns last month, or an FX rate applied on the wrong date. Numbers from this system feed invoices, hedges and shareholder reporting.
  
  
Scope
  
  

* Test strategy and test plans for the platform: deal capture, pricing and pricing periods, provisional and final invoicing, costs, demurrage and claims, P&L and margin, reporting
* Automated tests at API, data and UI level, integrated into CI so every change runs against them
* Realistic test data and scenarios — term contracts, multi-lot cargoes, price-formula deals, FX, late invoices, cost reallocation — and expected results someone in the business has signed off
* Regression testing of calculations: the same deal must produce the same P&L, and a past date must reproduce the P&L as it stood then
* Data and integration testing — market data feeds, imports from accounting and operations systems, reconciliation between the platform and the source it came from
* Reviewing agent-written code and agent-written tests critically: a test that always passes is worse than no test
* Working with users on acceptance testing and turning their “this number looks wrong” into a reproducible defect
* Release quality: what is safe to ship, what is not, and why

**Requirements**

* 4+ years in QA or software testing, with ownership of test strategy and automation on a business-critical product
* Strong test automation in Python (pytest or similar) or another mainstream language; API testing; UI automation with Playwright, Cypress or similar
* Good SQL and the ability to test data directly: write queries to check a calculation, find a population mismatch, prove a number wrong
